cards.name: Daily Protein Target
cards.purpose: Find out how much protein you need each day, adjusted for your age, training, goal and how you eat.
cards.eligibility: Adults aged 18 to 99 with healthy kidney function. Not for children, dialysis patients or people under medical nutrition therapy.

cards.name: Diabetes Risk Check
cards.purpose: Estimate your risk of developing type 2 diabetes over the next 10 years and see which of your own factors drive it.
cards.eligibility: Adults aged 25 to 84 without a diagnosis of diabetes. Not a diagnosis; symptoms are handled separately from the score.
